prompt: Which are real steps of GitHub flow? Choose all that apply.
explanation: GitHub flow is branch → commit → pull request → review → merge into the default branch (then delete the branch). Skipping review with direct pushes, like forced rebasing of other branches, is not the flow at all.

options.text: Create a branch for your change
Commit your work with messages explaining why
Open a pull request and discuss the change
Push straight to the default branch to ship faster
Rebase every other branch before merging
